product_contract.previous_turn_outcome: one bounded redacted same-scope immediate-predecessor fact frozen in the canonical REPEATABLE READ cut; a successful successor masks older failures
product_contract.unfinished_tools: no accepted attempt means definitely not dispatched; accepted attempt without result means outcome unknown and never authorizes automatic retry
product_contract.late_result: a result accepted after a prepared cut is invisible to that cut and appears only as an appended correction in the first covering cut
product_contract.tool_observation: observed UTC time, monotonic duration disposition, immutable exact-binding origin and optional trusted duration are attributes of the existing tool_results row
product_contract.freshness: a per-turn append-only frontier maps stable source-turn references to current, predecessor-tail or historical without rewriting an old tool result
product_contract.provider_runtime_observation: the exact provider members are source, trust, lifecycle, presence and body; internal contract, version, fingerprint and generation remain process-local proofs
product_contract.plan_carrier: Plan continuation and Plan-owned tool result use closed canonical JSON; delimiter markers are absent
product_contract.cancellation: ROOT and each child use an exact per-turn process-local set-once cause; explicit child cancellation atomically terminalizes the child turn and task, a completed child winner preserves its result lineage, and a committed Plan successor remains in a closed pending handoff until promoted or terminalized
product_contract.trusted_tool_duration: the neutral physical result carrier cannot grant trust: DirectKernelToolPort promotes an optional supplement only for the pinned Terminal binding and closed observation-action matrix
product_contract.strict_prefix: within one compatible Host, exact scope and epoch, SYSTEM and tools remain equal and messages remain equal or append only a suffix

deterministic_verification.strict_prefix_previous_outcome: VALUE then CLEARED appends each source-head transition once and never rewrites the installed prefix
deterministic_verification.strict_prefix_freshness: a new frontier appends while every historical tool-result provider message remains byte-identical
deterministic_verification.late_result_cut: an exact result accepted after cut A is absent from cut A and visible in covering cut B
deterministic_verification.result_cut_join: every timing/freshness result aggregate uses the central result-entry visibility helper
deterministic_verification.cancellation_faults: confirm-first child stop and Host close classify clean NONE, atomically settle turn/task/events, preserve a completed historical winner and its result lineage, and a pending automatic Plan successor remains owned through exact stop/close terminalization
deterministic_verification.trusted_duration_seal: only the pinned Terminal or Terminal-process observation action can promote the optional trusted supplement; a custom tool claim is ignored without negating its known result
deterministic_verification.provider_wire: generic runtime observation has exactly five members; tool body cannot escape the string boundary or forge outer timing; Terminal and Plan delimiter/schema carriers are absent
